We are seeking a meticulous QA Manual Tester with specialized expertise in Functional and Localization testing. In this role, you will ensure our software application functions flawlessly while delivering a native, culturally accurate user experience across multiple global markets. You will be responsible for end-to-end manual testing, designing comprehensive test cases, identifying critical bugs, and validating that our localized product versions align with regional language standards and cultural nuances.Key Responsibilities1. Functional Testing & Core QAAnalyze requirements: Review project specifications, user stories, and technical layouts to identify testing requirements.Test creation: Design, write, and maintain highly detailed manual test plans and test scenarios.Test execution: Perform functional, integration, smoke, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT).Defect tracking: Document, prioritize, and report software bugs with detailed reproduction steps using Jira.Bug verification: Collaborate closely with developers to retest bug fixes and verify overall system stability.2. Localization (L10n) & Internationalization (I18n) TestingLinguistic validation: Verify translation accuracy, text formatting, punctuation, typos, and grammar consistency across target locales.UI & Layout checks: Identify layout breaks, text clipping, truncation, and overlapping text caused by string length variations.Cultural adaptation: Validate that regional formats—such as date/time stamps, currencies, number systems, and symbols—are correctly implemented.Local functionality: Test whether localized features, third-party payment gateways, and regional hyperlinks operate identically to the core build.3. Collaboration & ReportingDaily syncs: Participate in daily scrum meetings, requirement grooming, and defect triage sessions.Status tracking: Update the QA Lead on daily execution progress, blockages, and overall build quality metrics.Required Skills and QualificationsEducation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Linguistics, Engineering, or a related field.Core Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of proven experience as a Manual QA Tester on web and mobile platforms.L10n Expertise: Strong background in localization QA processes, terminology databases, and internationalization standards.Language Skills: Professional proficiency in English, plus native or professional working proficiency in at least one other major language (e.g., Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Arabic).Tool Proficiency: Deep familiarity with test management and bug tracking platforms like Jira, TestRail, or Confluence.Attention to Detail: Exceptional eye for spotting minor UI anomalies, formatting errors, and subtle behavioral bugs.Preferred QualificationsFamiliarity with localization translation management systems (TMS) like Crowdin, Phrase, or Smartling.Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, or browser developer tools to inspect localized layout anomalies.Professional QA certifications such as ISTQB Certified Tester (Foundation Level or Certified Specialist).

A cadet pilot is a trainee sponsored or selected by an airline to undergo structured ground school and flight training. The role transitions an applicant with zero or minimal flying experience into a certified Commercial Pilot License (CPL) holder and qualified First Officer following airline standard operating procedures.Key ResponsibilitiesGround School Studies: Complete intensive theoretical training covering aviation law, meteorology, navigation, and aircraft systems.Flight Training: Log required dual and solo flight hours across domestic or international partner academies to pass regulatory check rides.Simulator Sessions: Train on advanced flight simulation devices for multi-engine operations, instrument ratings, and emergency management.Type Rating: Complete specific aircraft transition training (e.g., Airbus A320 or Boeing 737).Safety & Compliance: Adhere strictly to aviation safety standards and regulatory frameworks.

Role Overview We’re looking for a mid-level Azure Developer to design, build, and maintain cloud-native integrations and data solutions on Microsoft Azure. You’ll work across data platforms, API management, and serverless compute, with the autonomy to own instances end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop integrations using Azure Function Apps and Logic Apps
Work with Microsoft Fabric / Databricks for data engineering and analytics workloads
Build and maintain pipelines integrating with data lakes and data warehouses
Independently provision, configure, and manage Azure service instances
Develop, secure, and publish APIs via Azure API Management (APIM)
Define API specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger) following best practices
Implement and support Model Context Protocol (MCP) based integrations
Work with Azure AI Search to build search and retrieval solutions
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions
Troubleshoot, monitor, and optimize deployed integrations for performance and reliability
Required Skills & Experience

3–6 years of hands-on experience with Azure development
Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric or Databricks
Experience integrating with Azure Data Lake and Azure Synapse/Data Warehouse
Strong experience with Azure Function Apps and Logic Apps
Proven ability to independently manage Azure resources/instances
Experience with Azure API Management (APIM) — policies, security, versioning
Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server/client concepts
Solid understanding of API development lifecycle and specification definition (OpenAPI/Swagger)
Exposure to Azure AI Search (indexing, querying, semantic/vector search a plus)
Good understanding of Azure security, networking, and DevOps practices (CI/CD)
Nice to Have

Experience with .NET/C# or Python for Azure development
Familiarity with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
Knowledge of event-driven architecture (Event Grid, Service Bus)

Mobile Test Engineer

ConvergeSPORTS (USI) | Associate Analyst

About the Role

ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. Our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics.

This role sits within the Mobile App product team. The ConvergeSPORTS Mobile App is a fan-facing digital product that brings together content, identity, engagement, personalization, notifications, and commercial experiences. The team owns the end-to-end fan journey and works with Architecture, iOS and Android Engineering, Backend Engineering, Data, Design, and Go-to-Market to deliver measurable releases.

This role owns quality for the fan-facing mobile experience across Android and iOS. You are the last line of defense before a release reaches fans, and the first person to know when something is not right.

Key Responsibilities

Own Test Coverage

•       Design, write, and execute manual and automated test cases for new and existing Mobile App features

•       Build and maintain automated UI test suites for Android using frameworks such as Espresso or Appium

•       Validate API responses and data integrity across content, identity, personalization, and notification features

Find and Drive Out Defects

•       Log, triage, and track defects through resolution, working with Engineering to reproduce and verify fixes

•       Perform regression, exploratory, and smoke testing ahead of App Store and Play Store releases

•       Monitor crash reports, analytics, and post-release quality metrics to catch emerging issues early

Ship as One Team

•       Join sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness reviews to define coverage and acceptance criteria

•       Work day to day with Android and iOS Engineering, Product, and Design to clarify expected behavior

•       Document test plans, results, and known issues so the team can act on them quickly

Raise the Bar

•       Improve testing practices, tooling, and automation coverage over time rather than repeating manual effort

Reporting Relationships

Reports to Li-Shen Lee. Works as one team with Android and iOS Engineering, Backend Engineering, and Design, and partners with Product Management on release readiness.

Qualifications

Required

•       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

•       1+ years of experience in manual or automated testing of mobile applications on Android or iOS

•       Experience writing and executing test cases and test plans

•       Familiarity with at least one mobile test automation framework, such as Espresso, Appium, or XCUITest

•       Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries you serve.

•       Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred

•       Experience with API testing tools such as Postman

•       Experience with bug tracking and test management tools such as Jira and TestRail

•       Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for mobile app testing

•       Experience testing consumer-facing mobile apps in sports, media, or entertainment

Core Competencies

•       Detail-oriented and methodical about reproducing and isolating defects

•       Writes issues engineers can act on immediately

•       Comfortable working across Android and iOS in a fast-moving environment

•       Collaborative with engineering, product, and design

•       Curious about mobile platforms and motivated to improve how testing gets done

Why This Role Matters

A single bad release costs fan trust that takes months to earn back. This role protects that, and it is a direct path into deeper mobile engineering and automation work on a product people use every week.

Our purpose

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 
Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
Benefits to help you thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
